translations.web: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.
translations.bsb: And the people were greatly relieved to take the boy home alive.
translations.kjv: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
translations.asv: And they brought the lad alive, and were not a little comforted.
